description: Global Source Registry. S3 built it from the sources Kriton uses today; S4b (3 Nov 2026) added subject terms, entry subjects, and the fixed pages' selection rules and titles moved from official_evidence.official_pages (read only when KRITON_REGISTRY_RETRIEVAL is on; registry_shadow reads it when KRITON_REGISTRY_SHADOW is on). Each entry: country, topics, subjects, fact types, period, publisher, URL/host/domains, how it is selected, excerpt anchor and review date. Library entries carry a source class and fact types from their titles; test fixtures and tool descriptors are marked and do not count for coverage.
